text:
The 30-year costs more in total interest, often more than double. On $300,000 at 6.5%, interest is about $383,000 over 30 years versus about $170,000 over 15.

The 15-year has a much higher monthly payment (about $2,613 vs. $1,896 here). In practice, 15-year loans usually carry lower rates, which widens the gap further.
